# Express.co.uk

> UK news, politics, royal coverage, sport, lifestyle, finance, travel, motoring, and online puzzle games from the Daily Express.

Express.co.uk is the digital home of the Daily Express, covering breaking UK and world news alongside specialist sections for politics, royals, showbiz, sport, finance, travel, health, and consumer topics. The site also operates a substantial browser-based games and puzzles portal.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://www.express.co.uk/): Main homepage featuring latest headlines, analysis, and links to major sections.
- [About Us](https://www.express.co.uk/about-us): Editorial information, standards, ownership, and contact details.
- [Newsletters](https://newsletters.e.express.co.uk/): Newsletter signup hub for Express editorial products and updates.
- [Latest](https://www.express.co.uk/latest): Reverse-chronological feed of newly published Express stories.
- [Site Map](https://www.express.co.uk/site-map): Directory of site sections, topics, and article listings.
- [Privacy Notice](https://www.express.co.uk/privacy-notice): Privacy and data handling information for Express users.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.express.co.uk/terms-conditions): Terms governing use of the website and services.

## News
- [News](https://www.express.co.uk/news): Main news landing page for UK, world, and breaking stories.
- [UK](https://www.express.co.uk/news/uk): UK-focused reporting on domestic events, crime, weather, and public affairs.
- [World](https://www.express.co.uk/news/world): International news coverage and global breaking developments.
- [Politics](https://www.express.co.uk/news/politics): UK political reporting, party news, policy, and Westminster coverage.
- [Royal](https://www.express.co.uk/news/royal): Royal Family news, commentary, and palace-related reporting.
- [Weather](https://www.express.co.uk/news/weather): Forecasts, warnings, and weather-related UK news coverage.

## Showbiz & TV
- [Showbiz & TV](https://www.express.co.uk/showbiz): Entertainment landing page for celebrity, TV, film, and streaming news.
- [Celebrity News](https://www.express.co.uk/celebrity-news): Celebrity reporting, interviews, and entertainment headlines.
- [TV & Radio](https://www.express.co.uk/showbiz/tv-radio): Television and radio news, schedules, and presenter coverage.
- [Films](https://www.express.co.uk/entertainment/films): Film news, reviews, releases, and cast-related stories.
- [Books](https://www.express.co.uk/entertainment/books): Book news, author features, and publishing coverage.
- [Music](https://www.express.co.uk/entertainment/music): Music news, artist updates, and release coverage.

## Sport
- [Sport](https://www.express.co.uk/sport): Main sport hub covering football, tennis, F1, boxing, and more.
- [Football](https://www.express.co.uk/sport/football): Football news, transfer stories, match reaction, and club coverage.
- [Tennis](https://www.express.co.uk/sport/tennis): Tennis reporting on tours, Grand Slams, and player updates.
- [F1](https://www.express.co.uk/sport/f1-autosport): Formula 1 and motorsport news, analysis, and race coverage.
- [Boxing](https://www.express.co.uk/sport/boxing): Boxing news, fight previews, and fighter updates.
- [Golf](https://www.express.co.uk/sport/golf): Golf tournament coverage, player news, and results.
- [Cricket](https://www.express.co.uk/sport/cricket): Cricket reporting on international and domestic competitions.
- [Rugby Union](https://www.express.co.uk/sport/rugby-union): Rugby union news, fixtures, and team developments.

## Finance
- [Finance](https://www.express.co.uk/finance): Personal finance, pensions, savings, tax, and consumer money news.
- [Personal Finance](https://www.express.co.uk/finance/personalfinance): Household money, savings, bills, and budgeting coverage.
- [City](https://www.express.co.uk/finance/city): Markets, business, companies, and economic reporting.
- [Pensions](https://www.express.co.uk/finance/personalfinance/pensions): Pension policy, retirement income, and state pension updates.
- [Savings](https://www.express.co.uk/finance/personalfinance/savings): Savings rates, ISAs, and account-related consumer coverage.
- [Tax](https://www.express.co.uk/finance/personalfinance/tax): Tax changes, HMRC developments, and filing-related news.
- [Energy Bills](https://www.express.co.uk/finance/personalfinance/energy-bills): Energy cost updates, tariffs, and household bill guidance.

## Life & Style
- [Life & Style](https://www.express.co.uk/life-style): Lifestyle hub covering food, homes, garden, fashion, and wellbeing.
- [Food](https://www.express.co.uk/life-style/food): Recipes, cooking tips, product news, and kitchen advice.
- [Life](https://www.express.co.uk/life-style/life): General lifestyle features, relationships, and everyday advice.
- [Style](https://www.express.co.uk/life-style/style): Fashion, beauty, and personal style coverage.
- [Cars](https://www.express.co.uk/life-style/cars): Motoring news, reviews, road rules, and driving advice.
- [Garden](https://www.express.co.uk/life-style/garden): Gardening tips, seasonal advice, and plant care features.
- [Property](https://www.express.co.uk/life-style/property): Housing market, home ownership, and property-related news.
- [Health](https://www.express.co.uk/life-style/health): Health news, symptoms, NHS topics, and wellbeing reporting.

## Travel
- [Travel](https://www.express.co.uk/travel): Travel news, destination guides, airline updates, and holiday advice.
- [Cruise](https://www.express.co.uk/travel/cruise): Cruise news, itinerary features, and passenger advice.
- [Beach Holidays](https://www.express.co.uk/travel/beach): Beach destination ideas and holiday planning features.
- [City Breaks](https://www.express.co.uk/travel/city-breaks): Short-break destination guides and urban travel coverage.
- [UK Holidays](https://www.express.co.uk/travel/uk): Domestic travel ideas, staycations, and UK destination news.
- [Europe](https://www.express.co.uk/travel/europe): European destination coverage and travel updates.
- [Travel News](https://www.express.co.uk/travel/articles): General travel developments, disruption, and tourism reporting.

## Comment & Features
- [Comment](https://www.express.co.uk/comment): Opinion pieces, editorials, and columnist commentary.
- [Express Comment](https://www.express.co.uk/comment/expresscomment): Editorial comment and institutional opinion from the Express.
- [Columnists](https://www.express.co.uk/comment/columnists): Opinion articles from regular Express columnists and contributors.
- [Letters](https://www.express.co.uk/comment/letters): Reader letters and responses to current issues.
- [Features](https://www.express.co.uk/news/features): Longer-form features, explainers, and special reports.

## Puzzles & Games
- [Games Home](https://games.express.co.uk/): Main games portal for puzzles, card games, and daily challenges.
- [All Games](https://games.express.co.uk/allgames): Full directory of browser-based games available on Express.
- [Sudoku](https://games.express.co.uk/sudoku): Daily Sudoku puzzle with multiple difficulty options.
- [Sudoku Easy](https://games.express.co.uk/sudoku/easy): Easier Sudoku mode for beginners and casual players.
- [Quick Crossword](https://games.express.co.uk/express-quick-crossword): Daily quick crossword with hints and timed play.
- [Crusader Crossword](https://games.express.co.uk/daily-crusader-crossword): Daily cryptic-style Crusader crossword puzzle.
- [Word Wheel](https://games.express.co.uk/express-word-wheel): Daily word-building puzzle based on a central letter grid.
- [Solitaire](https://games.express.co.uk/solitaire): Classic solitaire card game playable in the browser.

## Puzzles & Brain Games
- [Codeword](https://games.express.co.uk/codeword): Number-to-letter codeword puzzle for vocabulary and deduction play.
- [Arrow Word](https://games.express.co.uk/arrow-word): Crossword-style word puzzle with directional clues.
- [Wordsearch](https://games.express.co.uk/wordsearch): Letter-grid wordsearch puzzle with themed hidden words.
- [Mahjong](https://games.express.co.uk/mahjong): Tile-matching Mahjong solitaire game for casual play.
- [Mini Crossword](https://games.express.co.uk/mini-crossword): Short-form crossword puzzle for quick daily sessions.
- [Crossword Challenge](https://games.express.co.uk/crossword-challenge): Competitive crossword-style puzzle game with score-based play.
- [eXchange](https://games.express.co.uk/exchange): Match-style word and tile puzzle game from Express.
- [Picture Cross](https://games.express.co.uk/picture-cross): Nonogram-style logic puzzle revealing hidden pixel images.
